opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scheme (A) open to undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva; Schemes (B) & (C) open to PhD student and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva; UK‑based members for conferences outside the UK and non‑UK members for UK conferences.
opportunities.summary: Grants to support attendance at Genetics Society meetings, other genetics‑related conferences, and virtual meetings, with travel, accommodation and registration costs covered.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or attending a UK‑based course; members must have been Society members for at least one year (students can apply as soon as they become members).
opportunities.summary: Grants of up to £1,200 to enable members to attend short genetics‑related training courses or collaborative visits to other laboratories.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK; students need a supervisor who is a Society member.
opportunities.summary: Awards up to £2,000 (usually below £1,700) to cover travel, accommodation, subsistence and consumables for field‑based genetic research projects.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Grants of up to £1,000 to support public engagement activities related to genetics, covering travel and material costs.

opportunities.title: One‑off Meeting Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members who wish to organise a genetics‑themed meeting not directly organised by the Society.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship for genetics‑themed meetings, with funding levels from a few hundred pounds up to several thousand pounds, plus a Carer’s Award.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics research communities seeking to run a regular series of meetings; applications submitted by prospective Special Interest Groups.
opportunities.summary: Funding up to £2,000 per year to support regular meetings of new Special Interest Groups in genetics.
